high_level_description: The image shows a person standing in front of a vibrant red backdrop adorned with shiny, vertical tinsel decorations that create a festive and glamorous atmosphere. The individual is wearing a black sleeveless crop top paired with a white skirt that has a black waistband. They have long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders and are accessorized with multiple necklaces, including a prominent one with a V-shaped pendant. On their left wrist, they wear a bracelet, and on their right wrist, there appears to be a wristband or bracelet as well.
